blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recent advances in specialized decision models have expanded the possibilities for zero-shot classification, yet their effectiveness on Vietnamese remains underexplored. This study evaluates four specialized decision models across 13 classification settings spanning six task groups, examining zero-shot performance, sensitivity to label-description language, and robustness to Vietnamese linguistic variations. The evaluation considers English, Vietnamese, and bilingual label descriptions, alongside common linguistic perturbations involving teencode, typographical errors, and diacritic removal. Under English label descriptions, JEV achieves the strongest overall performance, ranking first in 11 classification settings. The effects of label-description language vary across models and datasets, with bilingual descriptions providing no consistent improvement. Robustness experiments reveal that diacritic removal causes the most substantial performance degradation, reducing mean macro-$F_1$ by 9.51--15.47 points across model configurations, considerably more than teencode or typographical errors. These findings highlight the importance of label-description choices and Vietnamese orthographic variation when evaluating specialized decision models for zero-shot text classification.
blocks.zh: 最近专门决策模式的进展扩大了零射线分类的可能性,但对越南语的效能仍然没有得到充分利用。 这项研究评价了13个分类设置的4个专门决策模型,涉及6个任务组,审查零镜头性能,对标签描述语言的敏感性,以及对越南语言差异的稳健性。 评估考虑了英文、越南文和双语标签描述,以及涉及十进制码、打字错误和去除批评的常见语言扰动。 在英文标签描述下,JEV实现最强的整体性能,在11个分类设置中排名第一. 标签描述语言的效果因模型和数据集而异,双语描述没有提供一致的改进. 强健性实验显示,二甲酸去除导致性能最大幅度的退化,将模型配置的平均值宏F_1降低9.51-15.47分,大大超过十进制码或打字错误. 这些结论突出了标签描述选择和越南在评价零镜头文本分类的专门决定模型时的正体变化的重要性。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Text classification is a fundamental task in natural language processing, covering applications such as sentiment analysis, intent detection, and natural language inference. General-purpose large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated the ability to perform such tasks through zero-shot prompting. Recently, specialized decision models have emerged to provide structured predictions over predefined candidate options without free-form text generation. Models such as JEV supports classification through typed decision interfaces or user-defined schemas ( TypeSafe AI, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 文本分类是自然语言处理中的一项基本任务,涵盖情绪分析,意向检测,自然语言推论等应用. 通用大语言模型(LLMs)已经通过零镜头提示表现出执行这种任务的能力. 最近,出现了专门的决策模型,在不产生自由格式文本的情况下,就预先确定的候选选项提供结构化预测。 JEV等模型通过键入的决定界面或用户定义的策略支持分类(TypeSafe AI,2026).

blocks.en: Recent studies have evaluated specialized decision models across various tasks and domains. Deußer et al. (2026) evaluate JEV across 37 datasets, reporting strong performance on several tasks alongside considerable variation in results. Other studies examine decision models and compare their performance with general-purpose LLMs ( Duan et al., 2026 ; Ibrahim and Zaki, 2026 ) . Despite these efforts, their performance on Vietnamese text classification remains insufficiently characterized, particularly across tasks with different label inventories and linguistic characteristics.
blocks.zh: 最近的研究对不同任务和领域的专门决策模式进行了评估。 Deußer等人(2026年)评价了37个数据集的JEV,报告在几项任务方面表现良好,结果也有很大差异。 另一些研究审查了决策模式,并将其绩效与通用有限责任公司进行比较(Duan等人,2026年;Ibrahim和Zaki, 2026年)。 尽管作出了这些努力,它们在越南文本分类方面的表现仍然不够突出,特别是在具有不同标签目录和语言特征的任务方面。

blocks.en: Classification performance may also depend on how labels are specified and how input text is written. Previous research has shown that option labels can influence predictions in typed decision models even when label definitions are provided ( Azizi et al., 2026 ) . This motivates examining the effects of label-description language on Vietnamese classification tasks. Vietnamese user-generated text also contains abbreviations, nonstandard spellings, and omitted diacritics ( Nguyen et al., 2024 ; Nguyen et al., 2023 ) . Previous evaluations of Vietnamese pretrained language models have reported substantial performance degradation under diacritic removal ( Nguyen et al., 2023 ) . These findings motivate further investigation of decision-model sensitivity to both label descriptions and Vietnamese linguistic variations.
blocks.zh: 分类性能还可能取决于标签的指定方式和输入文本的写法. 以前的研究表明,即使提供了标签定义,选项标签也可以影响打字决定模型中的预测(Azizi等人,2026年)。 这促使人们审查标签描述语言对越南分类任务的影响。 越南用户生成的文本中也包含缩写,非标准的拼写,并省略了diacritics(Nguyen等人,2024年;Nguyen等人,2023年). 以往对越南语预训语言模型的评价表明,在二甲酸脱羧作用下,其性能明显退化(Nguyen等人,2023年)。 这些调查结果促使人们进一步调查对标签描述和越南语言差异的决策模式敏感性。

blocks.en: This study evaluates four specialized decision models across 13 Vietnamese classification settings spanning six task groups, with additional comparisons against previously published LLM results. The evaluation examines zero-shot classification performance, the effects of label-description language, and robustness to Vietnamese linguistic perturbations. Under English label descriptions, JEV achieves the highest performance in 11 settings. The effects of label-description language vary across models and datasets, while diacritic removal causes the largest performance degradation among the evaluated perturbations.
blocks.zh: 这项研究评估了越南13个分类环境的4个专门决策模型,涉及6个工作组,与先前公布的LLM结果进行了更多的比较。 评价审查了零镜头分类性能、标签描述语言的效果以及越南语言扰动的稳健性。 在英语标签描述下,JEV在11个设置中实现了最高性能. 标签描述语言的效果因模型和数据集而异,而二极删除则在被评价的扰动中造成最大的性能退化.

blocks.en: The main contributions of this study are: • Zero-shot evaluation of decision models for Vietnamese. A systematic comparison across diverse classification tasks, identifying differences in model performance at both task and class levels. • Analysis of label-description sensitivity and linguistic robustness. An investigation of the effects of label-description language and Vietnamese linguistic variations, revealing model-dependent behavior and substantial sensitivity to diacritic removal.
blocks.zh: 这项研究的主要贡献是: • 对越南人的决定模式进行零镜头评价. 系统比较各种分类任务,找出任务和类层次的模型性能差异. • 分析标签描述敏感性和语言稳健性。 对标签描述语言和越南语言变异的影响的调查,揭示了模型依赖的行为和对二极删除的实质性敏感性.

blocks.en: Zero-shot evaluation of decision models for Vietnamese. A systematic comparison across diverse classification tasks, identifying differences in model performance at both task and class levels.
blocks.zh: 越南决策模式零镜头评价. 系统比较各种分类任务,找出任务和类层次的模型性能差异.

blocks.en: Analysis of label-description sensitivity and linguistic robustness. An investigation of the effects of label-description language and Vietnamese linguistic variations, revealing model-dependent behavior and substantial sensitivity to diacritic removal.
blocks.zh: 标签描述敏感性和语言稳健性分析. 对标签描述语言和越南语言变异的影响的调查,揭示了模型依赖的行为和对二极删除的实质性敏感性.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Specialized Decision Models and Their Evaluation
blocks.zh: 2.1 专门决定模式及其评价

blocks.en: Specialized decision models produce structured predictions over predefined candidate options without free-form text generation. JEV and LAYA provide typed decision interfaces, while GLiNER2.5-multi-Decide supports multilingual classification with user-specified labels ( TypeSafe AI, 2026 ; Convai Innovations, 2026 ; Zaratiana et al., 2025 ) . These systems support related classification tasks despite differences in their architectures and inference interfaces.
blocks.zh: 专业决策模型在不产生自由格式文本的情况下,对预定义的候选选项产生结构化预测. JEV和LAYA提供打字决策界面,而GLiNER2.5-多Decide则支持多语种分类,并带有用户专用的标签(TypeSafe AI,2026;Convai Innovations,2026;Zaratiana等人,2025). 这些系统支持相关的分类任务,尽管它们的架构和推论接口不同.

blocks.en: Recent evaluations show that decision-model performance varies across tasks and evaluation conditions. Broad benchmarks report competitive results on several classification and knowledge tasks, alongside limitations on more demanding tasks and settings ( Deußer et al., 2026 ; Duan et al., 2026 ; Ibrahim and Zaki, 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ) . More focused studies reveal behavior not captured by aggregate scores. Experiments on legal inference identify sensitivity to request configuration, comparisons of JEV and LAYA show different performance and robustness profiles, and analyses of JEV report biases in the distribution of selected labels and ordinal scores ( Zhang et al., 2026 ; Li, 2026 ; Gao et al., 2026 ) . However, evidence across diverse Vietnamese classification tasks remains limited.
blocks.zh: 最近的评价表明,决策模式的业绩因任务和评价条件而异。 广泛的基准报告了若干分类和知识任务的竞争结果,同时对要求更高的任务和设置加以限制(Deußer等人,2026年;Duan等人,2026年;Ibrahim和Zaki,2026年;Li等人,2026年)。 更有重点的研究揭示了没有被总分捕获的行为. 法律推论实验确定请求配置的敏感性,JEV和LAYA的比较显示不同性能和稳健性特征,分析JEV报告在选定标签和正数分数分配上的偏差(Zhang等人,2026年;Li,2026年;Gao等人,2026年). 然而,越南各种分类任务的证据仍然有限。

blocks.en: 2.2 Label Specifications and Vietnamese Linguistic Robustness
blocks.zh: 2.2 标签规格和越南语言能力

blocks.en: The specification of candidate labels can influence zero-shot classification. Studies of generative LLMs show that label wording and definitions affect classification performance ( Mu et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ) . Related findings have been reported for typed decision models, where option names can exert greater influence than their accompanying definitions ( Azizi et al., 2026 ) . This evidence motivates examining the language of label descriptions as a separate factor in Vietnamese classification.
blocks.zh: 候选标签的规格可以影响零镜头分类. 对遗传性LLMS的研究表明,标签措辞和定义影响分类性能(Mu等人,2024年;Li等人,2025年)。 已报告了对输入式决定模型的相关调查结果,其中选项名称的影响可能大于其附带的定义(Azizi等人,2026年)。 这一证据促使人们将标签描述的语言作为越南分类的一个单独因素加以审查。

blocks.en: Robustness evaluation examines model behavior under controlled changes to input text. CheckList and TextFlint establish methods for testing linguistic transformations, while DecisionRobust extends perturbation-based evaluation to decision models and emphasizes the importance of validating that transformed inputs retain their original labels ( Ribeiro et al., 2020 ; Wang et al., 2021 ; Lan et al., 2026 ) . For Vietnamese, ViLexNorm documents nonstandard lexical forms in social media, and ViSoBERT reports performance degradation under diacritic removal ( Nguyen et al., 2024 ; Nguyen et al., 2023 ) . These findings motivate evaluating the effects of Vietnamese linguistic variations on specialized decision models.
blocks.zh: 强力评价在控制下的修改输入文本下的模型行为. CheckList和TextFlint建立了语言变换测试方法,而DecisionRobust则将基于扰动的评价扩展至决策模型,并强调验证变换投入保留其原始标签的重要性(Ribeiro等人,2020年;Wang等人,2021年;Lan等人,2026年). 对于越南人来说,ViLexNorm在社交媒体上记录了非标准词汇表,ViSoBERT则报道了在二甲解禁下的表现退化(Nguyen等人,2024年;Nguyen等人,2023年). 这些结论促使人们评估越南语言差异对专门决策模式的影响。

blocks.en: 3 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3 实验设置

blocks.en: 3.1 Tasks and Datasets
blocks.zh: 3.1 任务和数据集

blocks.en: The evaluation covers 13 classification settings from 12 Vietnamese datasets across six task groups: topic classification, emotion recognition, hate speech detection, sentiment analysis, intent detection, and natural language inference (NLI). The datasets include UIT-VSFC ( Nguyen et al., 2018 ) , NEU-ESC ( Mai et al., 2025 ) , UIT-VSMEC ( Ho et al., 2019 ) , UIT-ViOCD ( Nhung et al., 2021 ) , ViHSD ( Luu et al., 2021 ) , UIT-ViCTSD ( Nguyen et al., 2021 ) , PhoATIS ( Dao et al., 2021 ) , ViMQ ( Huy et al., 2021 ) , ViNLI ( Huynh et al., 2022 ) , ViANLI ( Huynh et al., 2026 ) , ViMedNLI ( Phan et al., 2023 ) , and vnNLI ( Anh et al., 2022 ) . UIT-VSFC is evaluated for both sentiment and topic classification.
blocks.zh: 评估涵盖来自12个越南数据集的13个分类设置,涉及6个工作组:专题分类、情感识别、仇恨言论检测、情绪分析、意图检测和自然语言推论。 数据集包括UIT-VSFC(Nguyen等人,2018年),NEU-ESC(Mai等人,2025年),UIT-VSMEC(Ho等人,2019年),UIT-ViOCD(Nhung等人,2021年),ViHSD. (Luu等人,2021年),UIT-VicTSD(Nguyen等人,2021年),PhoATIS(Dao等人,2021年),VimQ (Huy等人,2021年),ViNLI(Huynh等人,2022年),ViANLI(Huynh等人,2026年),ViMedNLI. (Phan等人,2023年),和vnNLI (Anh等人,2022年). 对UIT-VSFC进行情绪和主题分类评价。

blocks.en: 3.2 Models
blocks.zh: 3.2 模式

blocks.en: Four specialized decision models are evaluated. JEV ( TypeSafe AI, 2026 ) is accessed through its hosted API using the typesafe/jev-1.13 model version. The remaining three models are evaluated locally using open-weight checkpoints: LAYA Multilingual (322M parameters) 1 1 1 https://huggingface.co/convaiinnovations/laya-multilingual , GLiNER2.5-multi-Decide (287M parameters) 2 2 2 https://huggingface.co/fastino/GLiNER2.5-multi-Decide , and Quyet-1.0-Small (328M parameters) 3 3 3 https://huggingface.co/chinhnc/Quyet-1.0-Small . Quyet supports a maximum of ten candidate labels and is therefore excluded from PhoATIS, which contains 28 intent labels.
blocks.zh: 评价了四个专门决策模式。 JEV(TypeSafe AI,2026)通过它的主机API使用类型安全/jev-1.13型号版本访问. 其余三种模式通过开放式检查站在当地进行评估: LAYA多语言(322M参数) 1 1 1 https://huggingface.co/convaiinnovations/laya-多语言,GLiNER2.5-多Decide(287M参数) 2 2 https://huggingface.co/fastino/GLiNER2.5-多Decide,和Quyet-1.0-small(328M参数) 3 3 https://huggingface.co/chinhnc/Quyet-1.0-small. Quyet支持最多10个候选标签,因此被排除在包含28个意向标签的PhoATIS之外.

blocks.en: 3.3 Zero-Shot Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 3.3 零热评价议定书

blocks.en: All models are evaluated with frozen weights, without task-specific fine-tuning or labeled demonstrations. Each model receives the task input and its predefined candidate labels. To examine the effects of label-description language, three configurations are considered: English (EN), Vietnamese (VI), and bilingual English–Vietnamese (EN+VI). Label identities and their order remain fixed across configurations, while EN+VI combines the English and Vietnamese descriptions. English descriptions serve as the reference configuration for the main evaluation.
blocks.zh: 所有型号均采用冷冻重量评价,没有针对特定任务的微调或标签演示. 每个模型都收到任务输入及其预先定义的候选标签. 为了审查标签描述语言的效果,考虑三种配置:英语(EN),越南语(VI),和双语英语–越南语(EN+VI). 标签身份及其顺序仍然固定在各种配置之间,而EN+VI结合了英文和越南文的描述. 英文说明作为主要评价的参考配置。

blocks.en: Macro- F 1 F_{1} is the primary evaluation metric, with accuracy and weighted- F 1 F_{1} reported as supplementary measures. Macro- F 1 F_{1} is computed over classes represented in the gold test set. Robustness is measured by the change in macro- F 1 F_{1} between original and perturbed inputs under the same model configuration. The perturbation procedures are described in Section 5 .
blocks.zh: 宏观-F 1 F_{1}是主要评价指标,精确度和加权-F 1 F_{1}作为补充措施报告。 宏-F 1 F_{1}是比黄金测试组中代表的类别计算出来的。 稳健性通过宏-F 1 F_{1}在相同的模型配置下在原始输入和扰动输入之间的变化来衡量. 第5节叙述了扰动程序。

blocks.en: 4 Results and Analysis
blocks.zh: 4 结果和分析

blocks.en: 4.1 Overall Performance Across Tasks
blocks.zh: 4.1 各项任务的总体业绩

blocks.en: Table 1 presents the zero-shot classification results under English label descriptions. JEV achieves the highest macro- F 1 F_{1} in 11 of the 13 settings, with an average of 69.22 across the 12 settings shared by all models, followed by Quyet (53.61), LAYA (43.23), and GLiNER (31.26). Its advantage is particularly pronounced in intent classification, achieving 79.26 macro- F 1 F_{1} on PhoATIS and 80.20 on ViMQ, exceeding the next-best models by 51.54 and 41.43 points, respectively. Notably, PhoATIS contains 28 candidate intent classes, indicating strong performance even with a relatively large label inventory. Substantial variation is also observed within task families. In topic classification, JEV achieves 74.36 macro- F 1 F_{1} on UIT-VSFC but only 37.31 on NEU-ESC. Across the NLI benchmarks, all four models obtain their lowest scores on ViANLI, a dataset constructed using adversarial examples to challenge existing NLI systems. Nevertheless, JEV does not consistently outperform the other models, with Quyet achieving slightly higher scores on UIT-VSMEC and UIT-ViCTSD. Differences are also observed across evaluation metrics. On NEU-ESC, GLiNER achieves the highest accuracy (62.30%), whereas JEV obtains the highest macro- F 1 F_{1} (37.31%), illustrating how model rankings can differ depending on the evaluation metric.
blocks.zh: 表1在英文标签说明下列出零镜头分类结果。 JEV在13个设置中的11个实现最高的宏-F 1 FQQQ1},在所有模型共享的12个设置中平均达到69.22个,其次是Quyet(53.61个),LAYA(43.23个)和GLINER(31.26个). 它的优势在意向分类上特别明显,在PhoATIS上达到79.26 macro-F 1 F_{1}在ViMQ上达到80.20,分别超过51.54和41.43分的次佳模型. 值得注意的是,PhoATIS包含28个候选意向类,表明即使标签清单相对较大,也表现良好。 在任务家庭内也观察到很大的差异。 在主题分类方面,JEV在UIT-VSFC上实现了74.36 macro-F 1 F_{1}但是在NEU-ESC上只有37.31. 在整个NLI基准中,所有四个模型在ViANLI上都获得了最低分数,而ViANLI是利用对抗性实例构建的数据集,用以挑战现有的NLI系统. 尽管如此,JEV并没有一贯地超越其他模型,Quyet在UIT-VSMEC和UIT-VicTSD上取得了略高的分数. 各种评价指标也存在差异。 在NEU-ESC上,GLinER实现最高的精度(62.30%),而JEV获得最高的宏-F 1 F_{1}(37.31%),说明了模型排名如何根据评价度量而有所不同.

blocks.en: 4.2 Comparison with LLMs
blocks.zh: 4.2 与法学硕士比较

blocks.en: To contextualize the performance of specialized decision models, we compare their zero-shot classification results with those reported for five general-purpose LLMs in prior work Thin et al. (2024) . Figure 1 presents macro- F 1 F_{1} scores on 11 overlapping classification settings, with detailed results provided in Table 10 in the appendix. The comparison uses English label descriptions for the decision models and previously reported zero-shot prompting results for the LLMs.
blocks.zh: 为使专门决策模式的业绩符合具体情况,我们将其零镜头分类结果与先前工作中报告的5个普通用途有限责任管理项目的结果进行比较。 Thin等人(2024年). 图1列出11个重叠分类设置的宏-F 1 F_{1}分数,详细结果载于附录表10。 比较使用决策模型的英文标签说明,以及以前报告的LLMs的零镜头提示结果.

blocks.en: JEV demonstrates competitive performance against substantially larger general-purpose models, outperforming all three open-weight LLMs on five of the 11 settings: UIT-VSFC topic and sentiment classification, ViHSD, ViNLI, and vnNLI. It also achieves the highest reported macro- F 1 F_{1} on ViHSD (59.34), exceeding Qwen3-32B (57.56), and on UIT-VSFC sentiment classification (73.44), slightly surpassing GPT-4.1 (73.14). On NEU-ESC, JEV performs comparably to the strongest LLM, Gemma-3-27b-it (37.31 versus 37.32). Among the remaining decision models, Quyet is particularly competitive on UIT-ViCTSD, reaching 69.89 macro- F 1 F_{1} compared with 70.72 for Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct. Nevertheless, the relative performance varies across tasks. On UIT-VSMEC, GPT-4.1 exceeds JEV by 7.66 macro- F 1 F_{1} points, while GPT-4o achieves a 7.17-point advantage on ViMedNLI. Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct also outperforms JEV on ViMQ by 4.62 points.
blocks.zh: JEV在相当大的通用模型上表现出了竞争表现,在11个设置中的5个设置上都超过了所有3个开放重量级的LLMs:UIT-VSFC主题和情绪分类,ViHSD,ViNLI,和vnNLI. 它还在ViHSD(59.34)和UIT-VSFC情绪分类(73.44)上取得了最高的宏观报告-F 1 F_{1},略高于GPT-4.1(73.14)。 在NEU-ESC上,JEV对最强LLM,Gemma-3-27b-it(37.31对37.32)的性能可比较. 在余下的决定模式中,Quyet在UIT-ViCTSD上的竞争特别激烈,达到69.89 macro-F 1 F_{1},而Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct则达到70.72. 然而,各项任务的相对业绩各不相同。 在UIT-VSMEC上,GPT-4.1超过JEV7.66宏-F 1 F_{1}积分,而GPT-4o则在ViMedNLI上获得7.17分优势. Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct也比ViMQ上的JEV成绩高4.62分.

blocks.en: 4.3 Error Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.3 错误分析

blocks.en: On PhoATIS, JEV frequently predicts compound intents for queries annotated with a single intent. Of its 169 incorrect predictions, 140 include the gold intent together with an additional intent. The most frequent confusion is flight → \rightarrow flight#flight_time (109 cases). For example, JEV assigns flight#flight_time to the query “cho tôi biết các chuyến bay từ thành phố hà nội đến thanh hóa khởi hành sau 5 giờ chiều thứ tư” (“show me flights from Hanoi to Thanh Hoa departing after 5 p.m. on Wednesday”), although its gold label is flight . The departure time specifies a search constraint, not a separate request for flight-time information. JEV correctly identifies 19 of the 20 examples annotated with compound intents, suggesting that distinguishing requested information from query constraints is a prominent difficulty in this setting. However, the small number of compound examples limits conclusions about compound-intent recognition more broadly.
blocks.zh: 在PhoATIS上,JEV经常预测附加说明的询问的复合意图. 其169种不正确的预测中,140种包括金本位加附加意图. 最常发生的混乱是飞行~\右翼飞行#飞行_时间(109个病例). 例如,JEV将飞行#飞行时间分配给“cho tôi biawt các chuyawn bay tành phā hàn nài đến  thann hóa kháti hành 5 giß chienku themta tư”(“显示我在星期三下午5点后从河内飞往Thanh Hoa的航班”),尽管其金色标签是飞行。 出发时间规定了搜索限制,而不是单独要求飞行时间信息。 JEV正确识别了附加意向说明的20个例子中的19个,表明将所请求的信息与查询限制区分开来是这一背景下的一个显著困难. 然而,化合物实例数量少,限制了关于化合物意图识别的结论更为广泛。

blocks.en: On UIT-VSMEC, a prominent difference between JEV and Quyet concerns the distinction between anger and disgust . JEV misclassifies 80 of the 132 disgust examples as anger , obtaining an F 1 F_{1} of 21.94 for disgust , compared with 49.09 for Quyet. Conversely, JEV achieves higher recall for anger (85.00% versus 32.50%). Figure 2 shows these contrasting confusion profiles, which are not reflected in the relatively close overall macro- F 1 F_{1} scores.
blocks.zh: 在UIT-VSMEC, JEV和Quyet之间的显著区别涉及愤怒和厌恶的区别。 JEV将132个恶心例子中的80个错归为愤怒, 反之,JEV因愤怒而获得更高的召回(85.00 %对32.50%). 图2显示了这些对比性混淆剖面图,这些剖面图没有反映在相对接近的总体宏-F 1 F_{1}的分数中.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Comparison of JEV and Quyet confusion matrices on UIT-VSMEC.
blocks.zh: 图2:UIT-VSMEC上的JEV和Quyet混淆矩阵比较.

blocks.en: Another recurring error pattern is the disproportionate selection of particular labels. On UIT-VSFC sentiment classification, all four models overpredict neutral , assigning it to 395–1,875 examples against 167 gold instances, with neutral precision ranging from 7.36% to 27.09%. For example, the positive comment “trình bày vấn đề một cách chính xác và dễ hiểu” (“presents the material accurately and clearly”) is classified as neutral by JEV, LAYA, and GLiNER. On ViNLI, 551 of JEV’s 601 errors involve predicting neutral for examples with other gold labels. More extreme prediction concentration occurs for GLiNER, which assigns other to 692 of 693 UIT-VSMEC examples and hate to 6,678 of 6,680 ViHSD examples. These distributions indicate that, in some evaluated configurations, errors are dominated by repeated selection of particular labels rather than confusions spread across multiple categories.
blocks.zh: 另一个反复出现的错误模式是特定标签的不相称选择. 关于UIT-VSFC情绪分类,所有四个模型都过度预测中性,将其分配到395–1,875个实例,对167个黄金案例,中性精确度从7.36%到27.09%不等。 例如,JEV、LAYA和GLINER将“准确和明确地介绍材料”列为中性评论。 在ViNLI上,JEV的601个错误中有551个涉及用其他金色标签预测实例的中性. GLiNER出现更极端的预测浓度,GLiNER将693 UIT-VSMEC实例中的692个指定为其他,将6,680个ViHSD实例中的6,678个指定为仇恨. 这些分布表明,在一些被评价的配置中,错误主要是反复选择特定标签,而不是分散在多个类别之间的混淆.

blocks.en: Table 2: Changes in macro- F 1 F_{1} relative to English label descriptions (percentage points).
blocks.zh: 表2:相对于英文标签说明(百分点),宏-F 1 F_{1}的变化.

blocks.en: 4.4 Effects of Label-Description Language
blocks.zh: 4.4 标签-描述语言的影响

blocks.en: Table 2 shows distinct patterns of sensitivity to label-description language across models. JEV exhibits the most stable average performance, with macro- F 1 F_{1} varying by only 0.35 points across the three configurations and reaching its highest value under EN+VI descriptions (69.44). Quyet and LAYA achieve their highest average scores with Vietnamese descriptions, although the improvements over English are modest and both models perform substantially worse with bilingual descriptions. GLiNER, in contrast, performs best with English descriptions and exhibits the largest average degradation under VI and EN+VI. These results suggest that multilingual label descriptions do not necessarily benefit models built on multilingual encoders.
blocks.zh: 表2显示了不同模型对标签描述语言的敏感性的不同模式。 JEV表现出最稳定的平均性能,宏-F 1 F_{1}在三种配置中只有0.35分不同,并在EN+VI描述下达到最高值(69.44). Quyet和LAYA在越南语描述下取得了最高的平均分数,虽然比英语的改善不大,而且两种模式在双语描述下的表现都糟糕得多. 相比之下,GLINER在英语描述方面表现最好,在VI和EN+VI下表现出最大的平均降解. 这些结果表明,多语种标签描述不一定有利于基于多语种编码器的模型.

blocks.en:
The effects are also strongly task-dependent. Quyet, for example, gains 21.06 macro- F 1 F_{1} points on ViNLI with Vietnamese descriptions, largely through improved discrimination between other and neutral . However, the same configuration reduces its performance on ViHSD by 14.23 points, accompanied by increased misclassification of clean examples as offensive .
Additional instance-level prediction comparisons are provided in Appendix A.1 . This contrast suggests that the effect of description language is closely related to the distinctions between task-specific labels, rather than a general preference for Vietnamese descriptions. The degradation observed for LAYA and GLiNER is particularly pronounced in some settings. LAYA loses 18.70 macro- F 1 F_{1} points on ViMQ with bilingual descriptions, while GLiNER assigns other to every ViNLI example under both Vietnamese and bilingual descriptions. These findings indicate that label-description language affects not only classification performance but also the distribution of predicted labels, with substantial differences across models and tasks.
blocks.zh:
其影响也在很大程度上取决于任务。 例如,Quyet在越南的描述下在VinLI上获得了21.06 macro-F 1 F_{1)的分数,主要是通过改进其他和中立之间的区别。 然而,同样的配置使其在ViHSD上的性能减少了14.23分,同时伴随着对干净的例子越来越错误地归类为攻击性的例子.
附录A.1提供了其他实例一级的预测比较。 这种对比表明,描述语言的效果与任务特定标签之间的区别密切相关,而不是对越南描述的普遍偏好. 在一些环境中,LAYA和GLINER观察到的退化尤其明显。 LAYA在ViMQ上损失18.70 macro-F 1 F_{1}的点数带有双语描述,而GLINER则在越南语和双语描述下为每个ViNLI例子分配其他. 这些调查结果表明,标签描述语言不仅影响分类性能,而且影响预测标签的分布,在模型和任务之间有很大差异.

blocks.en: 5 Robustness to Vietnamese Linguistic Variation
blocks.zh: 5 越南语言变异的强力

blocks.en: 5.1 Perturbation Design
blocks.zh: 5.1 扰动设计

blocks.en: We consider three types of Vietnamese linguistic variation. Teencode introduces informal lexical substitutions commonly found in online communication, such as “không” → \rightarrow “ko” (“not”). Typographical noise simulates typing errors through Telex-related substitutions, diacritic modifications, and character-level edits. Diacritic removal removes Vietnamese tone and vowel diacritics, including the conversion of đ to d . Each perturbation is applied independently to the original test inputs while retaining the original labels. For NLI, teencode and diacritic removal affect both the premise and hypothesis, whereas typographical noise is applied only to the hypothesis.
blocks.zh: 我们考虑了三种类型的越南语言变异. Teencode引入了在线通信中常见的非正式词汇替代,如“không” →\rightarrow “ko”(“不是”)。 Typlogical噪声通过Telex相关替换,二亚语修改以及字符级编辑模拟打字错误. diacritic release 移除了越南语的语调和元音二甲酸,包括dđ的转换. 每次扰动在保留原标签的同时,独立应用于原测试输入. 对NLI来说,十进制码和二甲酸去除既影响前提又影响假说,而打字噪音仅适用于假说.

blocks.en: Table 3 summarizes perturbation coverage and character edit burden across the 13 evaluation settings, with dataset-level statistics provided in Appendix C . Coverage measures the proportion of modified inputs, while edit burden is the total character-level Levenshtein distance normalized by the original input length. Diacritic removal produces the highest coverage and edit burden, followed by typographical noise and teencode.
blocks.zh: 表3汇总了13个评价环境的扰动覆盖面和字符编辑负担,数据集一级统计数据见附录C。 覆盖度测量了修改输入量的比例,而编辑负担则是完全字符级的Levenshtein距离因原始输入长度而正常化. 糖尿病的清除产生最高的覆盖率和编辑负担,其次是印刷噪音和青少年代码。

blocks.en: Table 3: Perturbation coverage and character edit burden across the 13 evaluation settings.
blocks.zh: 表3:13个评价环境的扰动覆盖率和人物编辑负担。

blocks.en: 5.2 Performance Under Linguistic Perturbations
blocks.zh: 5.2 语言干扰下的绩效

blocks.en: Table 4: Changes in macro- F 1 F_{1} under linguistic perturbations relative to original inputs (percentage points).
blocks.zh: 表4:与原始投入相比,在语言扰动下宏观-F 1 F_{1}的变化(百分比)。

blocks.en: Table 4 reports changes in macro- F 1 F_{1} relative to unperturbed inputs. For each model, we use the label-description configuration that achieves the highest mean macro- F 1 F_{1} on the original test data (EN+VI for JEV, EN for GLiNER, and VI for LAYA and Quyet) and keep it fixed across all perturbation conditions. JEV maintains the strongest overall performance across all three perturbation types. Its mean macro- F 1 F_{1} across the 12 shared settings decreases from 69.44 on the original inputs to 59.93 under diacritic removal, 68.34 under teencode, and 66.37 under typographical noise, remaining above the other models in every condition. JEV achieves the highest macro- F 1 F_{1} in all 13 settings under diacritic removal and in 12 of 13 settings under each of the other two perturbations. Its lead over the next-best model, Quyet, also widens from 15.39 points on the original inputs to 21.35 points under diacritic removal.
blocks.zh: 表4报告了宏观-F 1 F_{1}相对于未扰动投入的变化。 对于每个模型,我们使用实现最高平均值-F 1 F_{1}的标签描述配置在原始测试数据上(EN+VI为JEV,EN为GLINER,VI为LAYA和Quyet),并在所有扰动条件下保持固定. JEV在所有三种扰动类型中保持最强的整体性能. 它在12个共享设置中的平均宏-F 1 F_{1}从原始输入值的69.44降至二极删除值的59.93,十进制码下的68.34和打字噪声下的66.37,在每种情况下仍高于其他模型. JEV在diacritic remove下的所有13个设置中以及另外两个扰动下各13个设置中的12个实现最高的宏-F 1 F_{1}. 它在次佳模型Quyet上的领先地位也从原始投入的15.39分扩大到二极删除下的21.35分.

blocks.en: Diacritic removal produces the largest average performance loss for every model, with decreases in 47 of the 48 model–setting comparisons shared by all four models. JEV exhibits the smallest mean reduction (9.51 points), followed by LAYA (13.77), GLiNER (14.75), and Quyet (15.47). The effects nevertheless vary substantially across tasks. On UIT-VSFC topic classification, GLiNER loses 46.60 points and predicts others for 3,164 of 3,166 instances; on the sentiment task, it predicts neutral for 3,112 instances, accompanied by a 34.12-point decline. Differences are also pronounced on vnNLI, where LAYA and Quyet lose 31.62 and 24.48 points, respectively, compared with only 3.46 for JEV. Prediction-level comparisons further show that diacritic removal changes 19.57% of JEV’s decisions on average, compared with 40.60% for Quyet and 54.29% for LAYA. GLiNER exhibits a similarly low flip rate (19.83%), but its predictions remain concentrated on particular labels in several settings. Detailed prediction transitions are reported in Appendix A.2 .
blocks.zh: Diacritic release对每个模型产生最大的平均性能损失,在48个模型中的47个模型 -- -- 所有4个模型共用的设定比较中减少。 JEV表现出最小的中减(9.51分),其次是LAYA(13.77分),GLINER(14.75分)和Quyet(15.47分). 然而,各项任务的效果差别很大。 关于UIT-VSFC主题分类,GLinER损失46.60分,并预测其他3,166例中的3,164分;关于情绪任务,它预测3,112例的中性,伴随着34.12分的下降. vnNLI上也出现差异,LAYA和Quyet分别损失31.62分和24.48分,而JEV只有3.46分. 预测层次的比较进一步表明,二极清除平均改变19.57%的JEV决定,而Quyet的40.60%和LAYA的54.29%. GLiNER显示同样低的翻转率(19.83%),但其预测仍然集中在几种情况下的特定标签上. 附录A.2报告了详细的预测过渡。

blocks.en: Teencode and typographical noise have smaller average effects, with mean reductions of 0.47–1.10 and 2.87–4.54 points, respectively. Although JEV retains the highest absolute performance, it does not consistently exhibit the smallest degradation: Quyet has the lowest mean loss under teencode, while LAYA is least affected by typographical noise. Notably, LAYA improves on UIT-ViOCD under all three perturbations, gaining 9.58 points under typographical noise. This improvement coincides with a reduction in its preference for non_complaint , from 480 of 549 predictions on the original inputs to 291 under typographical noise, closer to the 270 gold instances. Conversely, teencode causes notable declines on UIT-VSMEC for JEV (5.13 points) and Quyet (4.93 points). A targeted analysis of the Vietnamese negation marker không in Appendix A.3 further identifies differences in models’ sensitivity to its informal written forms.
blocks.zh: Teencode和打字噪音的平均效果较小,平均分别降低0.47–1.10和2.87–4.54分. 虽然JEV保留了最高的绝对性能,但它并没有一贯表现出最小的退化: Quyet在十进制码下的平均损失最少,而LAYA受印刷噪音的影响最小. 值得注意的是,LAYA在所有三次扰动下改进了UIT-ViOCD,在印刷噪音下获得了9.58分. 这一改进的同时,它对非申诉的偏好也随之减少,从对原始投入的549项预测中的480项减少到打字噪音下的291项,接近270项金矿。 相反,青少年编码导致JEV(5.13分)和Quyet(4.93分)的UIT-VSMEC显著下降。 对附录A.3中的越南否定标记không进行有针对性的分析,进一步确定了模型对其非正式书面形式敏感度的差异。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We presented a systematic evaluation of four specialized decision models for Vietnamese zero-shot text classification across 13 settings spanning six task families. Beyond overall classification performance, we examined the effects of label-description language, class-level prediction patterns, and robustness to Vietnamese linguistic variation. JEV achieved the highest macro- F 1 F_{1} in 11 of the 13 settings under English label descriptions and maintained the strongest average performance across all three linguistic perturbations. However, model behavior varied considerably across tasks and evaluation conditions. Label-description language produced model- and task-dependent effects, with bilingual descriptions offering no consistent advantage. Diacritic removal caused the largest average performance degradation for all four models, although JEV exhibited the smallest mean reduction under this condition. These findings demonstrate that strong zero-shot performance does not necessarily imply consistent behavior across label configurations and linguistic variations, highlighting the importance of evaluating specialized decision models beyond aggregate benchmark scores.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了对涉及六个任务家庭的13个背景越南零镜头文本分类的四个专门决定模式的系统评价。 除了总体分类性能外,我们还研究了标签描述语言的影响,阶级水平的预测模式,以及对越南语言变异的稳健性. JEV在英文标签描述下的13个设置中的11个实现了最高的宏-F 1 F_{1},并保持了所有三个语言扰动中最强的平均性能. 然而,模型行为在任务和评价条件上差异很大。 标签描述语言产生了模型和任务依赖效应,双语描述没有一致的优势. 糖尿病的清除造成所有四种模型的平均性能下降幅度最大,不过JEV在这种条件下的下降幅度最小。 这些调查结果表明,强烈的零镜头性能并不一定意味着标签配置和语言变异之间的一致行为,突出了评价超过总基准分数的专门决策模型的重要性.

blocks.en: Appendix A Prediction-Level Sensitivity
blocks.zh: 附录A 预测级别敏感性

blocks.en: We examine instance-level prediction changes under two evaluation conditions: variations in label-description language and linguistic perturbations of the input text. A prediction flip occurs when the predicted label differs between paired configurations. W → \rightarrow C, C → \rightarrow W, and W → \rightarrow W denote transitions from incorrect to correct, correct to incorrect, and between two incorrect predictions, respectively.
blocks.zh: 我们在两个评价条件下审查了实例一级的预测变化:标签描述语言的变化和输入文本的语言扰动。 当预测的标签在配对配置之间发生差异时,会发生预测翻转. W → 右旋 C , C → 右旋 W ,和 W → 右旋 W 分别表示从不正确到正确,正确到不正确,以及两个不正确的预测之间的过渡.

blocks.en: A.1 Label-Description Language
blocks.zh: A.1 标签描述语言

blocks.en: Table 5 presents selected prediction changes underlying the macro- F 1 F_{1} differences reported in Section 4.4 . On ViNLI, switching from English to Vietnamese descriptions changes 123 predictions for JEV but 930 for Quyet. For Quyet, this change corrects 682 previously incorrect predictions while introducing 151 new errors, consistent with its substantial improvement in macro- F 1 F_{1} . The effect is reversed on ViHSD, where the same change introduces 1,247 errors and corrects only 147. For LAYA, switching from Vietnamese to bilingual descriptions on ViMQ produces 393 newly incorrect predictions compared with 88 corrections. GLiNER also exhibits substantial prediction changes on ViNLI, with 987 of its 2,266 flips occurring between two incorrect labels.
blocks.zh: 表5列出了第4.4节所报告的宏观-F 1 F_{1}差异背后的一些预测变化。 在ViNLI上,从英语到越南语的描述的切换改变了对JEV的123个预测,对Quyet的930个预测. 对Quyet来说,这一变化纠正了682个先前不正确的预测,同时引入了151个新错误,这符合其在宏-F 1 F_{1}中的大幅改进. 其效果在ViHSD上被反转,同一种修改引入了1,247个错误,只更正了147个错误. 对LAYA来说,从越南语到维姆克语的双语描述的转换产生了393个新错误的预测,相比之下有88个更正. GLiNER在VinLI上也显示出实质性的预测变化,其2,266个翻转中987个在两个不正确的标签之间发生.

blocks.en: Table 5: Selected instance-level prediction changes across label-description configurations.
blocks.zh: 表5:各标签-描述配置中选定的实例级预测变化。

blocks.en: A.2 Linguistic Perturbations
blocks.zh: A.2 语言干扰

blocks.en: Table 6 summarizes prediction changes under diacritic removal, the perturbation producing the largest performance degradation in Section 5.2 . Results are averaged across the 12 shared evaluation settings, with each setting weighted equally. JEV exhibits considerably fewer prediction changes under diacritic removal than Quyet and LAYA. In particular, 11.73% of its predictions change from correct to incorrect, compared with 23.33% for Quyet and 27.95% for LAYA. Despite a similarly low flip rate (19.83%), GLiNER achieves substantially lower classification performance, with its predictions dominated by a single label in several settings. Its apparent prediction stability therefore partly reflects persistent label concentration.
blocks.zh: 表6汇总了二甲酸去除的预测变化,这种扰动产生了第5.2节中最大的性能退化。 12个共同评价环境的成果平均,每项评价的加权均匀。 与Quyet和LAYA相比,JEV在二分解作用下显示的预测变化要少得多。 特别是,其预测有11.73%从正确变为错误,而Quyet为23.33%,LAYA为27.95%。 尽管同样低的翻转率(19.83%),GLiNER还是实现了显著较低的分类性能,其预测在多个场合以单一标签为主. 因此,其明显的预测稳定性部分反映了持续的标签浓度。

blocks.en: Table 6: Instance-level prediction transitions under diacritic removal (%).
blocks.zh: 表6:二甲酸性去除的事例级预测过渡(%)。

blocks.en: A.3 Negation-Cue Sensitivity under Teencode
blocks.zh: A.3 青少年代码下的隐匿敏感度

blocks.en: We further examine the sensitivity of NLI predictions to informal variants of the Vietnamese negation marker không . We identify 194 instances across the four NLI benchmarks in which không occurs in the hypothesis but not the premise and is replaced by a teencode variant, such as “ko” or “k”, without modifying the remaining input text. Fixed expressions in which không does not function as negation, such as “không khí”, “không gian”, and “hàng không”, are excluded. Replacing không substantially reduces the proportion of contradiction predictions for LAYA and GLiNER, by 20.62 and 14.43 percentage points, respectively. The corresponding changes are considerably smaller for JEV (3.09 points) and Quyet (2.06 points). LAYA and GLiNER also experience larger accuracy reductions on these instances. These results indicate greater sensitivity to the surface realization of negation cues in LAYA and GLiNER, even when the remaining input text is unchanged.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步审查NLI预测对越南否定标记không的非正式变体的敏感性。 我们从四个NLI基准中找出194个例子,其中không出现在假设中,而不是前提中,并被“ko”或“k”等青少年编码变体所取代,而没有修改其余的输入文本。 không不具有否定作用的固定表述,如“không khí”、“không gian”和“hàng không”除外。 取代không将LAYA和GLINER的矛盾预测比例分别大幅降低20.62和14.43个百分点. JEV(3.09分)和Quyet(2.06分)的相应变化要小得多. LAYA和GLINER在这些案例中的准确度也有所下降。 这些结果表明,即使剩余输入文本没有变化,对LAYA和GLINER中否定提示的表面实现更加敏感。

blocks.en: Table 7: Effects of rewriting không on NLI predictions (194 paired instances).
blocks.zh: 表7:重写không对NLI预测的影响(194对偶实例)。

blocks.en: Appendix B Prompt and Schema Templates
blocks.zh: 附录B 提示和Schema 模板

blocks.en: Each evaluation setting specifies a task instruction, input fields, and an ordered set of candidate labels with descriptions. Single-text tasks use a text field, whereas NLI uses separate premise and hypothesis fields. Gold labels and example identifiers are excluded from model inputs. Figure 3 provides a schematic illustration using sentiment classification. The task specification is adapted to each model’s inference interface. JEV, LAYA, and Quyet use typed-choice questions with instructions and criteria , while GLiNER uses a classification schema with label descriptions and single-label prediction. We evaluate three label-description configurations: English (EN), Vietnamese (VI), and bilingual English-Vietnamese (EN+VI), with English preceding Vietnamese in the bilingual configuration.
blocks.zh: 每个评价设置都指定了任务指令,输入字段,以及一套有说明的有序候选标签. 单文本任务使用文本字段,而NLI则使用单独的前提和假说字段. 黄金标签和实例标识符被排除在模型输入之外. 图3利用情绪分类提供了图表说明。 任务规格适应每个模型的推论界面. JEV,LAYA,和Quyet使用带有指令和标准的打字选择问题,而GLINER则使用带有标签描述和单标签预测的分类方案. 我们评价三种标签描述配置:英语(EN),越南语(VI),以及双语英语-越南语(EN+VI),英语在双语配置中先于越南语.

blocks.en: Appendix C Perturbation Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 附录C 干扰实施细节

blocks.en: C.1 Perturbation Generation
blocks.zh: C.1 干扰生成

blocks.en: Teencode and typographical perturbations are generated using nom-vn v0.2.37, while diacritic removal uses the character mapping provided by pyvi v0.1.1. All inputs are normalized to NFC before transformation. Table 8 summarizes the stochastic generator parameters for teencode and typographical noise. OCR and word-segmentation perturbations are disabled in both conditions. Teencode uses dictionary-based slang substitutions, whereas typographical noise combines Telex-related errors, diacritic modifications, confusion-set substitutions, and character-level operations.
blocks.zh: Teencode和打字扰动是使用nom-vn v0.2.37生成的,而diacritic remove则使用pyvi v0.1.1提供的字符映射. 所有投入在转型前都与NFC正常化. 表8汇总了十进制码和打字噪音的成色生成参数。 OCR和词段扰动在两种条件下均被禁用. Teencode使用基于词典的slang替代,而印刷噪声结合了Telex相关的错误,diacritic修改,混淆设置替代,以及字符级操作.

blocks.en: Table 8: Stochastic perturbation generator parameters.
blocks.zh: 表8: Stochastic 扰动发生器参数.

blocks.en: Character-level operations are evaluated sequentially using a shared random draw, so the thresholds in Table 8 do not represent independent mutation probabilities. The max_edit_ratio parameter limits the internal operation budget for each unprotected segment, with a minimum budget of one, rather than imposing a strict bound on Levenshtein distance. Both stochastic transformations protect URLs, mentions, hashtags, digit-containing expressions, and emoji or symbol sequences. Typographical noise additionally protects selected Vietnamese negation forms, including “không”, “chưa”, “chẳng”, “chả”, and “đừng”. Random generation uses a base seed of 42, with seeds derived from example identifiers, input fields, and segment positions.
blocks.zh: 字符级操作采用共享随机抽取进行顺序评价,因此表8中的阈值并不代表独立的突变概率. 最大_ edit_ ratio 参数限制每个未受保护部分的内部运行预算, 最低预算为 1, 而不是对 Levenshtein 距离施加严格的约束 。 既保护URL、提及、标签、含有数字的表达方式,又保护emoji或符号序列。 此外,打字噪音还保护了选定的越南否定形式,包括“không”、“chúa”、“chúng”、“chàng”和“đừng”。 随机生成使用42个基种,种子来源于实例识别符,输入字段,以及片段位置.

blocks.en: C.2 Perturbation Statistics
blocks.zh: C.2 干扰统计

blocks.en: Table 9 reports the realized perturbation coverage and character edit burden for each evaluation setting. Coverage denotes the proportion of inputs modified, while edit burden is calculated as the sum of field-level Levenshtein distances divided by the total original input length. Both measures are computed on NFC-normalized strings. For NLI, the edit denominator includes both the premise and hypothesis, including the unchanged premise under typographical perturbations. The statistics cover 13 evaluation settings, comprising 33,350 setting–example pairs. UIT-VSFC is counted separately for topic and sentiment classification.
blocks.zh: 表9报告每个评价设置的实际扰动覆盖率和字符编辑负担。 覆盖度表示修改输入量的比例,而编辑负担则计算为场级Levenshtein距离除以全部原始输入长度的总和. 这两种措施都是根据NFC规范化的字符串计算的。 就NLI而言,编辑分母包括前提和假设,包括印刷扰动下不变的前提. 统计数字包括13个评价设置,包括33 350个设置-例对。 UIT-VSFC为主题分类和情绪分类分别计算.
